description: Start a situation clock. The clock tracks what happens if PCs don't intervene.

clockId.description: Optional clock ID if situation has multiple clocks

playerVisible.description: Whether players can see this clock on their HUD. Defaults to false — clocks are GM-state and revealing them at start is a spoiler. Leave hidden and call reveal_clock when the fiction surfaces the threat/deadline to the players.

name: start_situation_clock
